protocol.latency: postwarm triggered_at to React commit; coalesced latest telemetry received_at to React
protocol.history_proof: each of 100 vehicles >=3 postwarm models, every reported history_points >=890
protocol.limitation: Accelerated past-event receipt is a diagnostic, not an unmodified one-hour real-time protocol

derived_postwarm_stages.selection: Unique observed completed batches by prediction_stages_cutoff_at within postwarm measurement interval; no interpolation for unobserved batches
